name: panel-policy
description: Runs review and verifier subagents on the review model, counts the agents a turn spawns, and keeps a panel progress band above the prompt.

enforce.title: Enforce the review model
enforce.description: Re-point review and verifier spawns to reviewModel.

reviewModel.title: Review model
reviewModel.description: The model alias or id review and verifier spawns run on.

overrideFrom.title: Override from
overrideFrom.description: Comma-separated models a reviewer is moved off when the caller set one of them; an unset or inherited model moves too on a general-purpose spawn.

fanoutToast.title: Fan-out toast at
fanoutToast.description: Toast once when a turn's spawn count reaches this; 0 turns it off.

fanoutHold.title: Fan-out hold at
fanoutHold.description: Ask Proceed or Cancel on the Nth spawn of a turn; 0 (the default) never asks.

staleMinutes.title: Stale after (minutes)
staleMinutes.description: A member in flight longer than this is marked stale and leaves the in-flight count, so the band can clear without it; 0 never marks one stale.
